name: tool_config
description: Manage the user's command-tool manifests (~/.config/agentrunner/tools/<name>.json) — the ONLY way to write there; file tools cannot leave the workspace. A command tool wraps a local command as a model-callable tool: JSON manifest {name, description, command, timeout_s, params} where params is a JSON Schema object and the model's arguments arrive as JSON on the command's stdin. action 'save' validates the manifest exactly like discovery does (strict JSON, name rules, built-in collisions refused) BEFORE anything lands, and refuses to replace an existing manifest unless overwrite is set; 'remove' deletes a manifest; 'list' returns the user layer's manifests. Changes apply to NEW sessions — the current session's tool set was frozen at start.

action.description: save = validate and write a manifest; remove = delete one; list = read the user layer.

name.description: Tool name (bare identifier, becomes <name>.json). Required for save and remove; must equal the manifest's name field on save.

manifest.description: For save: the complete manifest JSON ({name, description, command, timeout_s?, params?}).

overwrite.description: For save: replace an existing <name>.json. Without this, saving over an existing manifest fails.
